description: Marks read, in one of three ways, with id naming a conversation (cosend, phone_thread) or a message (phone_message). where cosend clears the chat’s unread state for the whole workspace in Cosend; the customer sees nothing. where phone_thread tells WhatsApp the newest unread customer message was read, so the customer’s phone shows blue ticks on what they sent. where phone_message does the same for the one message named. The blue ticks reach a real person’s phone and cannot be taken back.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

where.description: cosend to mark a chat read in Cosend only; phone_thread to show blue ticks for the chat’s unread messages on the customer’s phone; phone_message to show them for one message.

name: mark_read
title: Mark chats read
